card.name: Linking words before cognitive test names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "of", "or" and commas right before the name of a psychomotor or memory test. Seen in drug-interaction text about alcohol or sedatives and their effects on performance.

modes.label: "the" before a named test
modes.description: The word "the" sits just before a named cognitive or psychomotor test such as the Digit Symbol Substitution Test.
modes.example: No additive effect was seen on<< the>> Delayed Word Recognition Test.

modes.label: Other links in test lists
modes.description: A comma, "of" or "or" appears inside a list of performance measures, where another test or measure comes next.
modes.example: No change in choice reaction time<< or>> sedation index was detected after dosing

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that begin physiology or psychology terms, and away from words about structure or shape.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the name of a memory or reaction-time test is given.
